title: LiveHealth.cards is a computed view of LiveAccess.read kept for the views; remove it once they switch on access
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/AppleHealthMetrics/LiveHealth.swift var cards (access.cards), read by LiveCards.swift live.cards[metric], LiveMetricPage.swift live.cards[metric] and many tests. Views should take the cards from LiveShown or a switch on live.access. Found in M5, 2026-11-11
